evidence.finding: The documented alpha web command can enable the legacy Node backend. That backend binds an operator-selected network host, starts detached native Ralph processes, persists PID/status/logs and can reconnect after server restarts. Agent work is owned by that server process tree rather than a browser connection. This is a self-hosted alpha mode; no managed Ralph cloud is supplied.

evidence.title: ralph-orchestrator: backend/ralph-web-server/src/api/rest.ts
evidence.locator: POST /api/v1/tasks autoExecute; serve.ts Dispatcher setup; runner/RalphTaskHandler.ts
evidence.finding: The alpha legacy Node REST API is explicitly for external consumers. Creating an unblocked task auto-enqueues it unless autoExecute is false, and the product-owned Dispatcher executes it through RalphTaskHandler without a human click for each run. The backend service must remain running; no cron-schedule claim is established.

evidence.title: ralph-orchestrator: crates/ralph-telegram/src/service.rs
evidence.locator: Telegram update polling and MessageHandler::handle_message; handler.rs human.guidance and human.response
evidence.finding: The Telegram integration routes incoming human messages to the selected loop. The polling service passes message text and chat ID to the handler, which appends human.guidance or human.response events to that loop; messages are not restricted to one sender identity in the inspected handler path. Distinct humans can send messages from their separate Telegram accounts (including a shared group chat) to steer the same loop; they do not share an ADE owner bearer credential. Per-human attribution and team permissions are not supplied by this path.

evidence.title: ralph-orchestrator: crates/ralph-cli/src/loops.rs
evidence.locator: Loop launch, diff and publish-review operations; core event loop; web backend routes and database schema
evidence.finding: Bounded inspection of the native loop and alpha web runtime found installed host CLI processes and Git-worktree separation, without product-managed container/VM provisioning, enterprise human SSO or named human team permissions. Hat roles are agent operational roles. publish-review pushes a branch and writes a Markdown handoff; it does not create or manage a pull request.

evidence.title: ralph-orchestrator: crates/ralph-core/src/diagnostics/mod.rs
evidence.locator: DiagnosticsCollector::new and RALPH_DIAGNOSTICS environment flag
evidence.finding: Ralph diagnostic collection is opt-in through RALPH_DIAGNOSTICS=1. When unset or another value, the collector creates no diagnostic directory or loggers. It controls local agent output, traces, hook-run telemetry and performance JSONL files; provider telemetry is separate.
